keyFindings.description: CI run 40942207302 (the pull_request merge ref with main a0f351e9) fails the dispatch lane at `bunx tsc --noEmit`: e2e/block-references.e2e.ts(235,30) Cannot find name 'getArtifactText'. Main's #2502 (8e0cb8c41) rewrote this file's import block and dropped getArtifactText, which this PR's new test uses at its lines 32 and 259; git merge-tree of 8d4fbcf3 with main a0f351e9 merges cleanly and reproduces the missing import. Merging would break main's dispatch lane. Forward-merge main (never rebase) and restore the import, or adapt the test to #2502's helpers.

envoy-go-race fails: the docs package hits go test's 30m timeout (FAIL docs 1801.2s; the failing settlement_credit tests report their deadline budget left, then panic: test timed out). The budget is tight on other branches too (INFRA-592 and INFRA-607 also timed out; INFRA-757 passed in 1336s), but this PR adds about 220 s of race time to the package: its three memory-bound tests take 69.7 s, 85.1 s and 65.5 s under -race locally (2 vCPU; non-race they take a few seconds). They measure heap growth, which race instrumentation distorts, and they test no concurrency. Skip them under the race detector (a race build-tagged constant, as the package's *_race_test.go files do for theirs) so the PR does not push the race lane past its budget, and say why in the skip.
